selected_evidence.requirement: Record sudo commands with user and timestamp in /var/log/sudo-commands.log
selected_evidence.summary: The test command produced a dedicated entry containing timestamp, invoking user root, run-as user nobody, and the full command.

selected_evidence.requirement: Keep sudo command entries out of the general system log
selected_evidence.summary: Both pre- and post-reboot test markers had zero matches in /var/log/messages.

Healthy baseline boot ID 96974ac3-f19e-45f7-9672-e880dd505cf8 was captured; the reboot was acknowledged and temporary unavailability observed; node1 returned with changed boot ID 023131ca-2d13-497f-83e4-e865f2a1aac1, active/enabled rsyslog, valid persistent configuration, preserved data, and successful post-reboot sudo logging.

commands.command:
printf 'OS='; . /etc/os-release; printf '%s %s
' "$NAME" "$VERSION_ID"; printf 'BOOT_ID='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id; printf 'RSYSLOG_ACTIVE='; systemctl is-active rsyslog 2>&1 || true; printf 'SUDO_VERSION='; sudo -V | sed -n '1p'; printf '%s
' '--- sudo logging directives ---'; sudo grep -RHE '^[[:space:]]*Defaults.*(syslog|logfile|log_input|log_output)' /etc/sudoers /etc/sudoers.d 2>/dev/null || true; printf '%s
' '--- rsyslog sudo routes ---'; sudo grep -RHE 'sudo|local[0-7]' /etc/rsyslog.conf /etc/rsyslog.d 2>/dev/null || true; printf '%s
' '--- general log targets ---'; sudo grep -RHE '^[[:space:]]*[^#].*(/var/log/messages|/var/log/syslog)' /etc/rsyslog.conf /etc/rsyslog.d 2>/dev/null || true

commands.command: printf '%s\n' 'Defaults syslog=local2' | sudo tee /etc/sudoers.d/00-command-logging >/dev/null && sudo chmod 0440 /etc/sudoers.d/00-command-logging && sudo visudo -cf /etc/sudoers.d/00-command-logging

printf '%s\n' 'if ($syslogfacility-text == "local2" and $programname == "sudo") then {' '  action(type="omfile" file="/var/log/sudo-commands.log" fileCreateMode="0600")' '  stop' '}' | sudo tee /etc/rsyslog.d/10-sudo-commands.conf >/dev/null && sudo rsyslogd -N1
